independent.summary: Invites are created with `findOneAndUpdate({upsert:true})`, but `ownerGuard` only hooks `save` (new doc) and `insertMany` — so the only production path that creates a WorkspaceInvite bypasses the write-then-check guard that models/WorkspaceInvite.js and docs/data-model.md both claim protects it. An invite upserted in the window between accountDeleter's content pass and the final sweep survives as a row pointing at a deleted workspace (GET /invites then shows it with workspaceName null until an accept 404s and drops it). The new accountDeleter race test passes anyway because it drives `create()`/`insertMany()`, not the route's upsert.

The last-owner invariant is read-then-write and not atomic: `membersOf()` reads the members array, then the guard counts owners, then a separate `updateOne` writes. With two owners, two concurrent demotions (or removals) each read two owners, each pass `ownersOf(workspace).length <= 1`, and both writes land — leaving a workspace with zero owners. Since no route can create an owner in a workspace that has none (invites and role changes are both owner-only), that state is permanent and the workspace can never be renamed, invited into or managed again.

`acceptMyInvite`/`declineMyInvite` write their refusal into `collabError`, which is only rendered inside the Collaborators group, not the "Invitations for you" group the buttons live in. A failed Accept (e.g. the workspace was deleted meanwhile → 404 'That is no longer there…') prints its message in a different group further down the panel, and if the reload empties `myInvites` the invitation row disappears with no message anywhere near where the click happened — contrary to the stated contract that a refusal is said next to the control that caused it.

triageGrades.reason: The change is almost entirely authorization: new owner-only membership/invite writes, role gates, invitee-matched invite acceptance, and the account-deletion refusal path.
No credentials, tokens or env secrets are added or read — the item deliberately mints no invite token and adds no mail credential.
No billing, pricing or AI-allowance code is touched; seat billing is explicitly out of scope.

Correct that destructive paths are touched — member removal, invite withdrawal, and accountDeleter's new `WorkspaceInvite.deleteMany` by email — even though the cited line is an upsert rather than a delete.
Nothing outbound is called; the whole point of the item is that no mail is sent and no third-party service is involved.
Only docs/roadmap/wishlist prose changed; no version bump, build, CI or deploy configuration.
